discovery: This Harbor configuration has no live host log mounts; agent logs are copied after the container run. The original local-file monitor could therefore only inspect completed usage.
first_trial: First direct container check observed two responses costing0.1639184; supplementary monitor first recorded six responses costing0.2235492, and then observed every completed-step total through all21responses/$0.6094926. No threshold crossed, no interruption, restart or replacement. Initial monitoring blind interval is retained as a limitation.
future_trials: The runner now reads scalar step-finish usage from /logs/agent/opencode.txt via docker exec for the exact trial container when the host log is absent. Complete malformed/unknown usage interrupts the owned Harbor process.
limits: Reported completed-response costs can lag an in-flight request; guard is not a provider cap.
scope: Host spending supervision only. Frozen model tasks, prompts, simulator, controller, assignments and model settings unchanged.
verification: Seven focused guard tests pass, including the actual scalar extractor and mocked whole-run budget/unknown-usage interruptions; independent review passes.
